name: angle_formatting
description: Angles whose text differs between Python's repr and JavaScript's toString: exponents, large and small magnitudes, negative zero, integral floats.

code.qiskit:
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
qc.rz(1e-05, 0)
qc.rz(1e-07, 0)
qc.rz(1e+16, 0)
qc.rz(1.5e+300, 0)
qc.rz(0.0001, 0)
qc.rz(123456789.125, 0)
qc.rz(-0.0, 0)
qc.rz(3.0, 0)
qc.rz(0.30000000000000004, 0)
qc.rz(1e+22, 0)
code.cirq:
import cirq

q = cirq.LineQubit.range(1)
# Cirq lists q[0] first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
circuit = cirq.Circuit(
    cirq.rz(1e-05)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(1e-07)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(1e+16)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(1.5e+300)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(0.0001)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(123456789.125)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(-0.0)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(3.0)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(0.30000000000000004)(q[0]),
    cirq.rz(1e+22)(q[0]),
)
code.pennylane:
import pennylane as qml

dev = qml.device("default.qubit", wires=1)


@qml.qnode(dev)
def circuit():
    qml.RZ(1e-05, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(1e-07, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(1e+16, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(1.5e+300, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(0.0001, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(123456789.125, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(-0.0, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(3.0, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(0.30000000000000004, wires=0)
    qml.RZ(1e+22, wires=0)
    # PennyLane lists wire 0 first in a state; Qiskit lists qubit 0 last. The circuit is the same.
    return qml.state()
